$note: Sync stamp for the vendored KnowledgeNetwork Design System snapshot. The DS is a Claude Design project with NO native version/release and NO per-file hashes in its manifest, so this file IS the diffable version marker of what state we adopted. To check for drift: re-read the DS via /design-sync, re-hash, and compare against `tokens.files` below; to adopt a change, re-vendor and update the hashes + syncedAt here. Graduating to a properly published/semver'd dependency is tracked in issue #66.

tokens.note: Byte-identical copies of the DS tokens/*.css. These hashes ARE the DS token-file fingerprints; a mismatch on re-hash means the DS changed. base.css + fonts.css are vendored but not yet imported (held for #64). 2026-08-05 re-sync: colors.css adopted a contrast pass (--border-hair 0.09->0.13, --border-rule 0.15->0.20, --text-2 bark-600->bark-700, --text-3 bark-400->bark-500); the other six token files re-hashed CLEAN against these fingerprints.

components.note: Typed .tsx ports of the DS .jsx sources (NOT byte-identical — jsx→tsx adaptation). The prop contract each is ported against is the DS .d.ts. The DS `_adherence` config (raw hex / px / non-token font bans) is the REFERENCE SPEC only — it lives in the DS project, is not vendored here, and oxlint was declined (#65); #61 authored those bans as native ESLint `no-restricted-syntax` rules in eslint.config.js, SCOPED to token-clean files (src/App.tsx, src/studio/StudioView.tsx, src/studio/AppToolbar.tsx) with src/ds/** exempt, and grows per migrated file — it is NOT yet a repo-wide error. Drift-check a port by re-reading its `from` source and comparing behaviour. 2026-08-05 full re-diff of all 17 ports against the DS: 9 CLEAN (CountBadge, AppHeader, DomainDot, TrailChip, StepDot, WalkCard, BinMark, PillButton, Toolbar); 6 DRIFTED and adopted (TreeRow drawn caret + exports caretStyle; InstrumentRow drawn bullet + exports bulletStyle; EdgeLegend crispEdges EdgeDash; NodeChip lit shadow stacks ring+lift; SectionLabel count --fw-medium; PresetButton inactive border --border-rule; DocHeader title colour fallback); PaneHeader adopted the auto-hide ✕ drift. InstrumentGroup newly ported. Recurring DS direction: text-glyph marks → drawn geometry, and sub-pixel hardening. eslint.config.js relaxes react-refresh/only-export-components for src/ds/** because DS components ship colocated style helpers (caretStyle, bulletStyle, FamilyColumn).

The .tsx port is trivial (the plan: co-locate leaf.png in src/ds/chrome/, `import leafUrl from './leaf.png'` so Vite fingerprints + base-rewrites it, and DROP the DS `base` prop as a documented deviation since the Vite import makes a runtime base path obsolete).
